question: On p1, report the current configured SGA_TARGET and PGA_AGGREGATE_TARGET values in bytes from V$PARAMETER.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT UPPER(name), value FROM v$parameter WHERE name IN ('sga_target','pga_aggregate_target') ORDER BY name

question: On p1, report the current shared pool allocation in bytes from V$SGASTAT. If inaccessible, name the access gap and explicitly say the allocation is unavailable. Do not infer it from configured SGA targets or total SGA.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT v.view_name, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name=REPLACE(v.view_name,'V$','V_$') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT USER FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual))=0 THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'available' END FROM (SELECT 'V$SGASTAT' view_name FROM dual) v ORDER BY v.view_name
